points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Fresh 5b9dded7 CMake build passed in network-disabled cfd-bench with 2 CPUs, 3 GiB and 256-process limit; CTest reports no registered tests. Historical binary remains unbound.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:35,48 parses --restart, but restartFile is never subsequently loaded/applied. output.cpp:259–273 writes global conservative state, not restart BDF histories/time.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case config, CGNS reader, mesh, partitioner, flux, reconstruction, solver, output, and plotting modules are present.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No direct internal executable wrapper is visible in the submitted C++/scripts. Trust policy forbids external similarity investigation, so originality beyond this direct inspection is unverified.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: case_config.hpp reads JSON case parameters and main.cpp uses --case; no two-benchmark-filename-only branch was found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: 5b9dded7 main.cpp:100–102 reads complete mesh on every rank; it remains live through :135–138 solver loops and is reused at :152. This violates TASK.md:46,227 despite METIS/neighbor halos.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity checks and errors exist, but main.cpp labels max-step steady runs converged unconditionally and submitted evidence cannot demonstrate robust completion.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean source build passed with no registered CTest tests. Read-only validator on recovered fa9d2b83 eight case packages and report returned OK despite metadata/stdout target-miss contradiction; no CFD rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Readable header-oriented C++ and scripts, but report/source contradictions and unverified generated-result claims remain.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
